features.name: Business Central Performance Toolkit (BCPT)
features.description: A multi-user benchmarking tool that simulates multiple users running simultaneously to measure performance, detect locking issues, and test system load.

features.name: BCPT DevOps Pipeline Integration
features.description: BCPT can be set up as DevOps pipelines to completely automate performance testing, running scenarios as part of CI/CD workflows.

features.name: Version 23 BCPT Out-of-Box DevOps Support
features.description: In version 23, BCPT is available out of the box in AL Go, allowing you to add a BCPT workload, run test scenarios, and compare results to a baseline run.

features.name: GitHub-Based Test Scenario Sourcing
features.description: BCPT can source test code directly from GitHub, eliminating the need to have test code built into the tool. Contributors can add scenarios to the open source project.
caveats: Currently 22 scenarios available, more expected to be contributed

features.name: Power BI Telemetry Reports for Performance Analysis
features.description: Performance results can be analyzed using Power BI app on telemetry with specific reports including performance toolkit results, deadlock detection, and database lock timeout pages.
caveats: Requires telemetry to be enabled before test run

features.name: Concurrency Testing and Deadlock Detection
features.description: BCPT is particularly effective for concurrent testing, flushing out deadlocks and database lock timeout issues in code with dedicated pages in Power BI reports.

features.name: SQL Statement Regression Detection
features.description: BCPT can track SQL statement counts in baseline comparisons, showing when code changes introduce new SQL constructs.
caveats: Duration differences can vary based on environment stability

features.name: KQL-based Test Results Analysis
features.description: The ability to analyze test results using Kusto Query Language (KQL) for flexible performance data querying.

features.name: DevOps Integration with Performance Reports
features.description: If running tests with DevOps, small performance reports are generated automatically as part of the pipeline.

features.name: Database Lock Timeout Diagnostics
features.description: Analysis shows which objects were affected by lock timeouts, distinguishing between background and UI sessions, helping identify problematic code areas.
caveats: BCPT runs everything with background sessions only

features.name: AL Stack Trace Analysis
features.description: Performance reports provide AL stack traces showing both the top and bottom of the call stack, revealing which code tried to take locks and which parts were hurt by lock timeouts.

features.name: SQL Query Analysis for Performance
features.description: In addition to AL stack traces, telemetry reports include SQL statement analysis and database view of performance issues, enabling deeper investigation into database-level problems.

features.name: BCPT Open Source Capabilities
features.description: Business Central Performance Toolkit is available as open source, reducing friction for adoption and enabling partner contributions and automation integration.

features.name: BCPT Documentation and Personas
features.description: Improved documentation at aka.ms/bcpt defining personas and scenarios for different use cases including pre-sales load testing and Business Central data analysis.

features.name: BCPT Pre-Sales Load Testing Guidance
features.description: Documented guidance for answering the question "Can Business Central handle a specific load for a prospect customer" as part of pre-sales engagement.

features.name: BCPT FAQ Documentation
features.description: Comprehensive FAQ covering all topics people want to know about Business Central Performance Toolkit.
